page.overview:
Who is Future Warrior in Black?

The の|Kokui no Mirai Senshi|"Future Warrior in Black Clothes"}} is an incarnation of の|Mirai no Gohan}} from a timeline wherein he did not have enough strength to save his Trunks and Bulma from being murdered by the Androids.

He is one of several "Warriors in Black" that are allied with Aeos. He and his fellow Warriors in Black support their leader, Aeos' mysterious yet malevolent intentions for the Super Space-Time Tournament as one of the many antagonists. He later realizes the error of his ways and supports the heroes in their battle against Demigra and his allies.

The Future Warrior appears as a tall, stern and muscular man missing his left arm and sporting a scar that runs down the left side of his face. Like his fellow Warriors in Black, he hides his identity with a hooded black cloak, as well as a brown masked undershirt to hide his mouth. He also wears dark-blue boots with yellowish stripes on the bottom edges.

After discarding his disguise, the Future Warrior appears to have his gi that he had worn similar to his father's, only in a different color palette, consisting of a closed black gi secured by a blue knot-tied obi over his waist, grey undershirt, brown pants, black wristbands, and black boots with grey stripes on the bottom edges.
